params.message:
Show the Bespreken steps as tabs

The three steps (relations, projects, people) were stacked in one long
block, so the projects and people sat far below a list of every relation.
They are now tabs at the top of Te bespreken, each with how many of its
items are discussed. The page opens on the first step with something left
to do, the open tab is kept in the link (?stap=), and saving the last open
item of a tab opens the next item in the following tab.
